name: deepseek-harness-desktop
description: Unofficial local-first, plugin-friendly Cursor-style workbench for DeepSeek Harness

scripts.dev: pnpm runtime:manifest && pnpm --filter @dhd/shared build && concurrently -k --kill-timeout 2000 --names workbench,shell --success command-shell "pnpm --filter @dhd/workbench dev" "pnpm --filter @dhd/shell dev"
scripts.release:check: pnpm build && pnpm runtime:manifest:packaged && node scripts/check-release-runtime.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @dhd/shared build && pnpm --filter @dhd/workbench build && pnpm --filter @dhd/shell build && pnpm runtime:manifest
scripts.test:contract: pnpm runtime:manifest && pnpm --filter @dhd/shared build && pnpm --filter @dhd/shell build && node scripts/check-capabilities.mjs && node scripts/check-turn-controller.mjs && node scripts/check-change-projection.mjs && node scripts/check-context-source.mjs && node scripts/check-host-ipc-driver.mjs && node apps/shell/scripts/check-agent-session.mjs && node scripts/check-ipc-contract.mjs && node scripts/check-upstream-desktop.mjs
